public_reference.observation: Dark shake siding above pale lap siding, paneled garage and four side window pairs.
North and west elevations of the two-story main roof.
Alley-end open covered parking, slender supports, pale window trim and upper vertical siding.
Continuous north walk and siding bays showing the return along the full roof.
Sage lap siding, crossing south gable, white window frames, open exterior balcony and slender supports.
Buff masonry, staggered two wing roofs and centered recessed glazed entrance.
East wing masonry return and public exterior sign.
Continuous red brick facade with two separate stair approaches and two window levels.
Harris-facing open parking bay under the west volume.
Property manager's tour associated with the east address.
Pale horizontal siding, raised front stair and an open carport on the east end.
